newsitem.title: USA: American Power sees 20-25 pct 97 eps growth.
newsitem.headline: American Power sees 20-25 pct 97 eps growth.

text.p: American Power Conversion Corp said on Thursday it felt it was well-positioned to post 20 percent to 25 percent growth in revenues and earnings per share in 1997.

"Based on APC's second quarter results and the company's current business outlook, we continue to believe that APC is well positioned to generate full year 1997 revenue and earnings per share growth in the 20 to 25 percent range," said Rodger Dowdell Jr, chief executive and president.
These forecasts were consistent with company guidance, he said. American Power designs, makes and markets power protection equipment.
Dowdell said the target assumed American Power could maintain or slightly improve operating profitability in the second half of the year. It was now at 18.5 percent of sales, he said.
In the second quarter, American Power reported second quarter earnings of $0.28 per share versus $0.20 per share in the year-ago second quarter.
